children: Saint-Gobain said it appointed Annica Hagen as chief artificial intelligence officer on Sept. 1.
The French building-materials supplier on Monday said it appointed Hagen to the newly created role to structure and scale the AI initiatives across the business.
Hagen, who joined the company in 2023, was also appointed to the group executive committee, it said.
